component.name: Fractile
component.summary: Place windows on a grid and restore your workspace

description.p: Fractile opens a small grid over the focused window. Drag across cells, or use the arrow keys, and the window fills that area. Global shortcuts, per-monitor panels, margins, gaps and named layouts are supported.

Fractile also saves which applications and windows were open and puts them back after a restart or crash: monitor, workspace, size and position. It does not restore unsaved content inside applications. Apps are only reopened with your approval.
Fully supported on X11 desktops. Wayland support depends on the compositor; see the compatibility matrix.
